chunks.text:
users are able to create Kit Orders in two ways:

1)By selecting the Program and then creating the OC for the Kit Order.
2)By directly selecting the Packing Kit and placing the order without selecting any Program.

Due to the second flow, the Kit Order does not get mapped to any Program, because of which the subsequent linkage and mappings configured in the system do not function properly.

All the mappings, linkages, and process flows configured and delivered to the customer are based on the Program structure. However,
when users create Kit Orders directly through the Packing Kit without selecting a Program, these Program-based linkages are bypassed.
